paite: Huai thilte zoh in Athen a kipan Paul apawt a, Korinth ah ahohta hi.
heading: Korinth Khua Ah Paul
english: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.

paite: Huan amin Akuila, Juda khat amu a, huai mi Pontus gam a piang ahi a, Klaudias in Judate tengteng Rome a kipan pawt thu apiak ziak a azi Priscilla toh Itali gam a kipan hong tung phet ahi uhi. Huai mite kiang ah Paul atungta hi.
english: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

paite: Anasep uh kibang ahih ziak in amau akikoppih in nna asemkhawm ua; anasep uh puanin bawl ahi.
english: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

paite: Sabbath teng in sinagog ah chitaktak in thu agen zel a, Judate leh Grikte thuzoh atum hi.
english: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

paite: Masidonia gam a kipan Silas leh Timothi ahong tun un, Paul tuh kha phutluih in thu nasem in a-om a, tua Jesu zaw Khrist ahi chih Juda mite kiang ah atheihpih zel hi.
english: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

paite: Himahleh akalh un agensia ua, Paul in apuan asing a, akiang uah, “Na sisan moh uh noumau lutung ah om hen; kei zaw ka hul ahi; tuban Zentelte kiang ah ka paita ding,” achi hi.
english: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”

paite: Huan huai a kipan apai a, amin Titas Justas mi khat inn ah alut a, huai mi'n Pathian abe zel hi, a-inn leng sinagog toh kizom ahi.
english: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

paite: Huan Krispus pa sinagog heutu in a-inkuanpihte tengteng toh Toupa agingta a, Korinth a mi tampi'n leng za in agingta ua, baptisma atang uhi.
english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

paite: Zan in Toupa'n Paul kiang ah mengmu bang in, "Lau ke'nla, dai lou in thu gen zel in;
english: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;

paite: kei na kiang ah ka om akei hiam, sihna ding in kuamah in na tung ah khut akha kei ding uhi; hiai khua ah mi tampi ka nei ngal a," achi hi.
english: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”

paite: Huan huai ah alak uah Pathian thu hilh in kum khat leh kha guk a-omta hi.
english: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

paite: Huan Akaia gam-ukpa Gallio ahih lai in Judate'n kituak in Paul kalh in buaina abawl ua, vaihawmna tutphah ma ah api uhi.
heading: Gallio Leh Paul
english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

paite: “Huai mi'n dan lou bang in a Pathian be ding in mi athuzoh," achi uhi.
english: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”

paite: Paul in adawn dekleh Gallio in, Judate kiang ah, "Judate aw, hiai thil diklou thu hiam, thilhihkhelh thu hiam bek hileh, pel lou in ka hon awlmoh ding hi.
english: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

paite: Himahleh thumalte leh minte, noumau dan thu lel zaw noumau kingaihtuah zaw un; ke'n zaw huchibang thu ngaihtuah ka ut kei," achi hi.
english: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”

paite: Huan vaihawmna tutphah a kipan in amau adelhkheta hi.
english: So he drove them from the judgment seat.

paite: Huan Grik mi tengteng in sinagog heutu Sostheni aman ua, vaihawmna tutphah ma ah avua uhi. Gallio in athilhih uh khawk asa kei hi.
english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

paite: Huai zoh in Paul ni sawttak ataam nilouh a; huai zoh in unaute kampha in akha a, huai a kipan Siria gam lam ah long in apaita a, akiang ah Priscilla leh Akuila leng apai uhi. Paul in thuchiam aneih ziak in Kenkriai ah sam amet phot hi.
heading: Siria Antiok A Kik Nawnna
english: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

paite: Huan Ephesa atung ua, huai ah amau anusia a; himahleh amah kia sinagog ah alut a, Judate kiang ah chitaktak in thu asutpih hi.
english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

paite: Huan sawt deuh taam ding in akhou ua, himahleh ama'n lem asa kei a,
english: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

paite: "Pathian in aphalleh na kiang uah ka hong nawn ding," chi in kampha in akhen a, Ephesa a kipan long in apaita hi.
english: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

paite: Huan Kaisaria ah ahong kai a, Jerusalem ah ahohtou a, saptuamte chibai buk in, Antiok ah ahohsukta hi.
english: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

paite: Huan huai a sawt kuam a-om nung in apai nawn a, nungzuite tengteng hihhat in Galatia gam leh Phrigia gam atawnsuak vek hi.
english: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

paite: Huan Juda mi khat, amin Apollos, Aleksandria a piang, mipiltak, Ephesa ah ahohsuk a; ama'n Laisiangthou anak theih mahmah hi.
heading: Ephesa Ah Apollos
english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

paite: Hiai mi'n Toupa Lampi thu zilsa ahi a, lungsim a phatuamngaitak ahih ziak in Toupa thu ahilh zel hi, Johan baptisma thu kia athei hi.
english: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

paite: Sinagog ah hangsantak in thu agen hi. Huchi in Priscilla leh Akuila in athugen azak un, a-inn uah leh akiang ah Pathian Lampi thu kichian sem in ahilhchianta uhi.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

paite: Ama'n Akhaia gam a paikai atuptak in unaute'n ahanthawn ua, amah ana kipahpihna ding un nungzuite kiang ah lai agelhsak uhi. Huan atun in, Pathian hehpihna ziak a gingtate nakpitak in apanpih hi.
english: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

paite: Vantang theih in Judate nakpitak in aseldong a, Laisiangthou zang in tua Jesu zaw Khrist ahi ngei chih atheisak hi.
english: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
